Thinke but hovv poore thou vvaſt, hovv obnoxious; / VVhom a ſmall lumpe of fleſh could poyſon thus.

To begin then vvith his Experiment of the burning VVood, it ſeems to me to be obnoxious to not a fevv conſiderable Exceptions.

Novv then, vve being thus obnoxious to fallacy in our apprehenſions and judgements, and ſo often impoſed upon by theſe deceptions; our Inferences and Deductions muſt needs be as unvvarrantable, as our ſimple and compound thoughts are deceitful.

In learning the uſeful part of every profeſſion, very moderate abilities vvill ſuffice; great abilities are generally obnoxious to the poſſeſſors. Life has been compared to a race; but the alluſion ſtill improves, by obſerving, that the moſt ſvvift are ever the moſt apt to ſtray from the courſe.

examples.translation: 这场骚乱和英格蘭的骚乱一样，都是从议会拒绝批准一项令人厌恶的税收开始的；但所有的相似之处都在这里结束了。

examples.text: Someone jolted my arm and the contents of my glass spilled onto an immaculate white dress. I felt obnoxious.
examples.translation: 有人搖晃著我的手臂，我的杯子裡的東西濺到了一件無瑕的白色連衣裙上。我覺得很討厭。

examples.text: I WOULD HAVE been nine or ten when my mother chased me up a thorn tree with a ceremonial hippo-hide whip. What my crime was, I forget. My mother was, and remains, a woman of exceptional forbearance. I must have done something so obnoxious as to beggar belief.
examples.translation: 我九歲或十歲的時候，我媽媽用儀式用的河馬皮鞭子追著我爬上一棵荊棘樹。我的罪行是什麼，我忘記了。我的母親過去和現在都是一個非常寬容的女人。我一定做了一些令人討厭的事情，以至於让人难以置信。

examples.text: I always feel out of place when I am around people. I feel obnoxious if I laugh or talk too much.
examples.translation: 當我和人在一起時，我總是感到格格不入。如果我笑太多或說話太多，我會感到討厭。

examples.text: He felt obnoxious and knew perfectly well that he would have no explanation whatsoever had anyone discovered him, but she looked so alluring, so untroubled, so fortunate, that his only concern was the terrible crack the shutter made...quiet as it was.
examples.translation: 他感到很討厭，而且很清楚如果有人發現他，他將無法解釋，但她看起來如此迷人，如此無憂無慮，如此幸運，以至於他唯一關心的是百葉窗發出的可怕的破裂聲……尽管它是如此安静。

examples.text: He was an especially obnoxious and detestable specimen of a man.
examples.translation: 他是一個特別令人討厭和可憎的男人的樣本。

examples.text: Throwing stones at the bus is another example of your obnoxious behaviour.
examples.translation: 向公共汽車扔石頭是你令人討厭的行為的另一個例子。

examples.text: 还是从他的树木燃烧实验开始谈起，在我看来，对于这个实验，不考虑某些重要的例外情况是不行的。
